desc:
The Laser Garden is a laser tower with a garden theme. In this tower, you must follow the instructions such as don't step on the grass, don't get splashed by water, don't step on pollen, etc. I have packaged this tower in a unique way so that you can enjoy the fresh atmosphere of the garden.

In this tower, free items such as Korblox, Headless, Char Me, boards, and carrying features are provided.

This tower is still in the experimental stage, so there will be further updates in the future.

To avoid spoilers, I've prepared various hidden shortcuts that you can find and try out! But don't leak the shortcuts... shuutt.

That's all from me, thank you and good luck!


Inspired by:

Kiwamimu Wallhop Tower (flowers concept), Kebun Tower, Flowers Tower, Chicken Tower, Mastering Wallhop Tower (finish stage), Suka Laser Tower
